rules.statement: A constructive trust arises where a person has transferred property subject to a notarial agreement to reconvey within a specified period, and they cannot enforce the agreement because the period has elapsed.
rules.supporting_quote: If this is so, a trust under section 83 will also arise where a person has transferred property subject to a notarial agreement to reconvey within a specified period, and he cannot enforce the agreement because the period has elapsed.
